title: Parler, large

settings.description: Lea speaks in a bright, upbeat and very expressive tone with a slightly high pitch, at a slightly fast pace. Very clear audio, very close-sounding, with almost no background noise.

tricks: The voice is steered by a written description of the speaker, not by tags
Pace is asked for in the description (slightly fast) because speed is ignored
Um is written out as a word

why: Parler's biggest checkpoint with a written description of a bright, upbeat speaker, since a description is its only expressive control.
